source_papers: D03 Lee & Swaminathan (2000); D05 Llorente et al. (2002)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: Volume state may distinguish information diffusion from liquidity-driven price pressure.
exact_signal_sketch: zscore_60(past_return_60 excluding last 5 days) × zscore_252(log turnover_60); freeze one orientation after literature review, not after returns.
expected_direction: ambiguous ex ante; test continuation and reversal as mutually exclusive preregistered hypotheses
required_data: QFQ close, turnover/free-float shares, trading status
point_in_time_requirement: all rolling inputs through signal close t; execution no earlier than t+1
multiple_testing_risk: high if multiple windows/signs are tried
falsification_condition: independent sample shows no RankIC, no monotonicity and no net long-only difference; or direction flips
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: at least 5 years, 500 stocks and 120 rebalance dates; not a statistical theorem
suitable_for_current_theme_project: no for discovery; frozen transfer check only
student_knowledge_required: RankIC, double sorts, interaction terms, point-in-time data

source_papers: D04 Gervais et al. (2001); D06 Barber & Odean (2008)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: Unusual volume relative to a stock’s own history may capture attention or information arrival.
exact_signal_sketch: pct_rank_time(turnover_t,252) or robust z-score; primary continuous signal, one 95th-percentile event view.
expected_direction: author evidence often positive at short horizons; A-share direction left open
required_data: turnover, amount, free float, news/announcement flags, price-limit status
point_in_time_requirement: historical rolling distribution only; no revised shares outstanding
falsification_condition: no incremental future-return relation after size/liquidity/attention controls or effect is entirely same-day/untradable
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: 2,000+ distinct shock events across broad market
student_knowledge_required: event sampling, robust normalization, clustered errors

source_papers: D01 Karpoff (1987); D04 Gervais et al. (2001); D06 Barber & Odean (2008)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: A breakout with abnormal volume may reflect information/attention, but can also be price pressure.
exact_signal_sketch: max(close_t/max(close_t-60:t-1)-1,0) × max(zVolume_60,0); compute at close, trade t+1 if executable.
expected_direction: unknown; continuation is the primary falsifiable claim only if preregistered before data
required_data: QFQ close, volume/turnover, limit and suspension flags, executable next-open/close prices
point_in_time_requirement: 60-day high must use t-1 and earlier; next-day execution
main_bias_risk: look-ahead from same-close execution and ex-post breakout/volume thresholds
falsification_condition: effect disappears at t+1 executable prices, after costs, or under one locked threshold in final data
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: at least 1,000 executable breakout events and multiple regimes
student_knowledge_required: rolling maxima, execution lag, event dependence

source_papers: D02 Campbell et al. (1993); D05 Llorente et al. (2002)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: Gradual volume increase could reflect information diffusion or sustained liquidity demand.
exact_signal_sketch: OLS slope of log(volume) over 5 days, standardized by 60-day slope history; no staircase drawing rules.
point_in_time_requirement: only consecutive trading observations through t
main_bias_risk: serial correlation, earnings/news clustering, arbitrary shape filters
falsification_condition: continuous slope has no stable conditional relation and discrete variants alone appear significant
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: 5 years broad market; 10,000 stock-date observations after dependence-aware sampling

source_papers: D02 Campbell et al. (1993); D05 Llorente et al. (2002)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: Low-participation advances could mean weak supply or low-liquidity price pressure; mechanisms imply opposite directions.
expected_direction: unknown; continuation and reversal must be separate hypotheses
point_in_time_requirement: all windows lagged correctly; t+1 execution
main_bias_risk: story fitting after seeing whether continuation or reversal wins
falsification_condition: neither preregistered direction survives final data and costs
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: at least 3,000 qualifying stock-dates outside theme concentration
evidence_grade: narrative translation with indirect Tier1 support

source_papers: D02 Campbell et al. (1993); D05 Llorente et al. (2002); Chordia & Swaminathan (2000)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: Slow information adjustment, low attention and illiquidity can produce continuation or reversal.
required_data: QFQ close, turnover, suspension and limit status
point_in_time_requirement: historical-only inputs; t+1 executable return target
main_bias_risk: choosing 'support' tolerance and direction after the chart
falsification_condition: locked direction is absent or reverses across regimes/final sample
evidence_grade: narrative translation with indirect Tier1 support

economic_or_behavioral_rationale: Public announcements may change expected cash flows, attention or discount rates; an event study measures reaction, not a tradable rule.
exact_signal_sketch: Predefine event source/time; estimate market+industry model on [-250,-30]; report AR/CAR on [0,1] and [-1,5] with clustered inference.
required_data: timestamped announcements, stock/market/industry returns, theme exposure
point_in_time_requirement: event list and timestamps frozen before return inspection; use first public time
main_bias_risk: event selection, overlapping events, industry contamination
turnover_risk: not applicable as a portfolio factor
falsification_condition: CAR not different from calibrated null; result vanishes with industry control or is driven by overlapping events
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: at least 30 non-overlapping events for inference; otherwise descriptive only
student_knowledge_required: market model, CAR, clustering, event timing

source_papers: E03 Somefun et al. (2022); F01 Hu et al. (2021)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: A theme measure should isolate common residual movement beyond industry/style exposures and use historical membership.
exact_signal_sketch: At each t, residualize constituent returns on market+industry+size; breadth=share of point-in-time members with positive residual return over 20 days.
expected_direction: positive breadth would imply continuation only as a preregistered hypothesis
required_data: historical theme membership, industry, size, returns, trading status
point_in_time_requirement: membership and classifications as known on t; no current-list backfill
main_bias_risk: survivorship, membership backfill and common-event dependence
falsification_condition: no incremental RankIC/portfolio spread beyond market and industry; or membership audit fails
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: multiple themes or 500+ stocks; one 56-stock theme is not enough for discovery
suitable_for_current_theme_project: no new discovery; existing negative result remains unchanged
suitable_for_broad_market_sandbox: yes only if historical membership exists
evidence_grade: Tier1 allocation method plus project null evidence

idea_name: Equal-budget random-search control for future formula mining
source_papers: B01 White (2000); B03 Bailey et al. (2017); C01 AutoAlpha; C03 Yu et al. (2023); C04 RiskMiner; C07 Shi et al. (2025)
economic_or_behavioral_rationale: A search method is useful only if it beats a simple sampler under identical data, grammar and evaluation budget.
exact_signal_sketch: Before any automated search, sample legal canonical formulas from the same grammar; match candidate count and parameter tries; compare effective-alpha yield and final locked performance.
expected_direction: not a return direction; methodological control
required_data: formula grammar, canonicalizer, complete trial ledger, fixed evaluator
main_bias_risk: baseline underfunding and hidden adaptive human trials
falsification_condition: MCTS/LLM fails to improve yield or locked performance versus random search under equal budget
minimum_sample_requirement: planning threshold: enough broad-market history for a separate final lockbox; exact size set in future preregistration
student_knowledge_required: search algorithms, multiple testing, experiment design
